scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
purpose: Focused source-only finite96MiB physical log bound decision on observed HOST filesystem.
filesystem_observation: HOST-FILESYSTEM-OBSERVATION.json: closest existing HOST ancestor ext4, 4096B allocation units. Intended output directory absent; no mkdir. This does not by itself locate Docker Root Dir/logfile or prove allocation bound there.

ordering_findings.fact: Normal success waits for exit and checks exited state before finally logs. On start/wait/inspect failure finally still attempts wait then logs, each exception caught. A failed wait is not a producer-stop certificate.
Cleanup runs stop,kill,wait,logs,inspect,rm in order but catches each failure; allow_failure=True accepts nonzero stop/kill/wait, so logs can run while producer remains alive.
Local calls are sequential and refuse unresolved prior local command retirement; this bounds local clients, not daemon-side ReadLogs FD lifetime.
At most2 source-level logs CLI invocations/container in one Owner.run path, no follow option. This is not a proved bound on daemon request multiplicity absent client/transport binding.

reader_lifetime.daemon_logs_go: ReadLogs creates async watcher; goroutine defer ConsumerGone on ctx cancellation/stream completion. No synchronous return-to-local-client proof of raw-fd close.
reader_lifetime.logfile_go: readLogsLocked opens currentFile and defers Close; openRotatedFiles max-file2 opens at most1 rotated file; files closed after tailFiles. A blocked reader can retain up to2 original inodes as they become unlinked. ReadConfig.Follow=false limits continuing reads but cannot certify a hard close deadline.
reader_lifetime.missing_premise: No active reader during every growth interval is not established by current owner ordering; local client join is not positive daemon reader retirement.

conditional_payload_arithmetic.qualification: 4096B rounding only is NOT an upper bound on ext4 preallocation, delayed allocations, extent-tree/bitmap/journal metadata, or delayed release.

whole_bound_repair_spec.owner_ordering: Before either logs call, obtain affirmative producer/log-copier completion with current container identity. Stop/kill return status alone insufficient; after failure omit logs while retaining its command/error evidence. Final pre-cleanup logs must not precede this completion check. This is a proposed source change, not implemented here.
whole_bound_repair_spec.reader_condition: Exclusive campaign ownership must cover daemon log consumers/raw-FD readers, not merely command scheduling. If reads overlap growth, bind maximum actual daemon ReadLogs requests and positively account their raw-FD lifetimes; retain all uncertain inodes until positive retirement.
whole_bound_repair_spec.allocation_condition: For actual Docker log filesystem, prove conservative total physical growth including preallocation and metadata <=96MiB. With zero unlinked readers the proved payload is32196874B and overhead allowance68466422B; with4 pinned inodes overhead allowance4072674B. Need exact running filesystem/kernel allocation behavior and relevant tunables, or an independently enforced hard allocation cap with bounded backing growth. statvfs unit rounding is insufficient.
whole_bound_repair_spec.admission_condition: Bind actual Docker Root Dir/log path and same filesystem identity; preserve16GiBHOST/12GiBscratch floors plus full backing growth. No admission from this report.

exact_missing_hard_premise: A source/implementation-bound maximum for physical ext4 allocation beyond the two named log files (or beyond bounded retained inodes), including transient allocation/metadata, on the actual Docker log filesystem; additionally current source does not establish zero active readers during growth. Thus source logical rotation limits plus statvfs cannot prove96MiB physical bound.
